references.text: Describes the conquest of the land from Mount Hermon to Bashan, including Og, king of Bashan, and his territory.
Mentions Mount Hermon and Bashan as part of the lands conquered from the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.
Tells of the victory over Og, king of Bashan, and the conquest of his land.
Refers to the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, which was given to the tribe of Manasseh.
Repeats the boundary description of the kingdom of Og of Bashan, including the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites.
Describes the distribution of Gilead and Bashan, including the borders of Geshur and Maakah.
Tells of Sihon, king of Heshbon, his kingdom, and the Israelite victory over him.
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
